entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西头 noramala 疑为 no en hora mala 之缩合，但汉字'吧'与音写 hit 均标[残]（声调 T99 污損），材料不足以定释义。

entries.en: Go ahead and go; you may as well go (bien te puedes ir)
Go now; go at once
entries.notes: 西头 'day' 疑为 dale/ya 之写误，据'去即'与音写 ching vu 定为'即刻去'；次字声调 T99 难辨（字形尚明）。

entries.zh: 去啦——好言软语地叫人走
entries.en: Go away — said with affection (a loving dismissal)
entries.notes: 西注 disho con amor（以爱语说）；'勝'字疑代语气词（啦/囉），义从西注与音写 chi la 推定。

entries.en: Go away; leave, depart
entries.notes: 音写第三段 cuonhate 未详（疑行末窜字或另词），主义据 開去 与 (Vete) 互证。

entries.en: Go away for now; leave it for the present (por agora)
entries.notes: 末字'即'与首字同音写 chia，对应存疑、或为语助字；主义据 'por agora' 与'且'。

entries.en: Go off to that side; step aside (a ese lado)
once; a time, a passage (una vez)
to arrive; up to; one's turn
entries.notes: Vez 配'到'，取'轮到/及至'义而非'次数'义，义项归属系推断。

entries.en: a time (counting word: times, occurrences)
entries.notes: 汉字形作'逼'而音写 pien 指向'遍'，形音不合；从音写与 Vez 义项定为'遍'。

entries.en: again; another time (otra vez)
entries.notes: '載'字与 Vez 直义不接；音写 chey 疑读 chài，与'再（otra vez）'音近，故定为'又一次'，存疑。

entries.en: repeatedly; to go round and round (dar vueltas)
entries.notes: 音写栏杂入西语 dar bueltas（绕圈、反复）而非闽南语；首字声调 T99 难辨，字形'沓'尚明。

entries.en: to encounter, meet with; that which befalls one
entries.notes: Vez 配'遭'，取'所遭、际遇'义，义项归属系推断。

entries.en: a time, an occasion (e.g. 'once', 'twice')

entries.zh: 邻居；邻人（殖民地语境亦指市镇在籍居民）
entries.en: neighbor (vecino; in colonial usage also a registered town resident)
neighbors; the folk of one's vicinity
the people next door; one's close neighbors

entries.zh: 隔壁人（一墙之隔的邻人）
entries.en: the person beyond the wall; the next-door neighbor (pared en medio)
next door; adjoining, separated only by a wall
the natives of the land; local people
